newsitem.title: FRANCE: Arthuis says presumption of accord on Russian debt.
newsitem.headline: Arthuis says presumption of accord on Russian debt.

text.p: French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said on Tuesday there was the "presumption" of an accord between France and Russia on the repayment of tsarist debt.
"There is a presumption of an accord, but not a final accord," he said. "They are looking for the blotting paper at the moment."
Arthuis, speaking to reporters ahead of a news conference by Prime Minister Alain Juppe and Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin, gave no further details.

Chernomyrdin, in Paris for a two-day visit, said before leaving Moscow that Russia would pay the debt run up by its pre-1917 tsarist government and repudiated by the Soviet Union after the communist revolution.
French Foreign Trade Minister Yves Galland however has warned French holders of the pre-revolutionary Russian bonds against building up unreasonable expectations.
